g.text: • Order route applies the JWT filter, then a Redis
• Valid tokens pass X-User-Id and X-User-Role
• The POST returns after the order is saved; payment
• Payment skips a duplicate order.placed for an
• Simulated payment succeeds 85% by default; failure
